{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module EmailService where

import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as C8
import qualified Data.Text as T
import qualified Data.Text.Encoding as TE
import Data.Char (ord, chr, isAlphaNum)
import Data.Word (Word8)
import Data.Bits (xor)
import System.IO (hPutStrLn, hFlush, Handle)
import Network.Socket
import qualified Crypto.Cipher.AES as AES
import qualified Crypto.Cipher.Types as CT
import qualified Crypto.Error as CE

-- | Storage record for queued emails
data EmailRecord = EmailRecord
  { erTo      :: BS.ByteString
  , erFrom    :: BS.ByteString
  , erSubject :: BS.ByteString
  , erBody    :: BS.ByteString
  } deriving (Show)

-- | Normalize unicode text to ASCII-safe representation
-- Uses NFD normalization then strips non-ASCII
normalizeHeader :: T.Text -> BS.ByteString
normalizeHeader t = 
  let normalized = T.filter (\c -> ord c < 128) t
      -- Fold fullwidth characters to their ASCII equivalents
      folded = T.map foldFullwidth normalized
  in TE.encodeUtf8 folded

-- | Fold fullwidth Unicode characters to ASCII range
-- Fullwidth chars U+FF01-U+FF5E map to U+0021-U+007E
foldFullwidth :: Char -> Char
foldFullwidth c
  | ord c >= 0xFF01 && ord c <= 0xFF5E = chr (ord c - 0xFEE0)
  | otherwise = c

-- | Sanitize a header value by removing CR and LF characters
-- This prevents CRLF injection in email headers
sanitizeHeaderValue :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
sanitizeHeaderValue = BS.filter (\w -> w /= 13 && w /= 10)

-- | Encrypt data for storage using AES-128-ECB
encryptForStorage :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
encryptForStorage key plaintext =
  let padded = pkcs7Pad 16 plaintext
      cipher = case CE.eitherCryptoError (CT.cipherInit key :: CE.CryptoFailable AES.AES128) of
                 Right c -> c
                 Left e  -> error $ "Cipher init failed: " ++ show e
  in CT.ecbEncrypt cipher padded

-- | Decrypt data from storage
decryptFromStorage :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
decryptFromStorage key ciphertext =
  let cipher = case CE.eitherCryptoError (CT.cipherInit key :: CE.CryptoFailable AES.AES128) of
                 Right c -> c
                 Left e  -> error $ "Cipher init failed: " ++ show e
      decrypted = CT.ecbDecrypt cipher ciphertext
  in pkcs7Unpad decrypted

-- | PKCS7 padding
pkcs7Pad :: Int -> BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
pkcs7Pad blockSize bs =
  let padLen = blockSize - (BS.length bs `mod` blockSize)
      padding = BS.replicate padLen (fromIntegral padLen)
  in BS.append bs padding

-- | PKCS7 unpadding
pkcs7Unpad :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString
pkcs7Unpad bs
  | BS.null bs = bs
  | otherwise  = 
      let padByte = BS.last bs
          padLen  = fromIntegral padByte
      in BS.take (BS.length bs - padLen) bs

-- | Build the email record from user input
-- Input is received as Text, normalized, then stored encrypted
buildEmailRecord :: BS.ByteString -> T.Text -> T.Text -> T.Text -> T.Text -> EmailRecord
buildEmailRecord key toAddr fromAddr subject body =
  let -- Step 1: Normalize unicode to ASCII
      toNorm   = normalizeHeader toAddr
      fromNorm = normalizeHeader fromAddr
      subjNorm = normalizeHeader subject
      bodyNorm = TE.encodeUtf8 body
      -- Step 2: Sanitize headers (remove CRLF)
      toSafe   = sanitizeHeaderValue toNorm
      fromSafe = sanitizeHeaderValue fromNorm
      subjSafe = sanitizeHeaderValue subjNorm
      -- Step 3: Encrypt for storage
      toEnc   = encryptForStorage key toSafe
      fromEnc = encryptForStorage key fromSafe
      subjEnc = encryptForStorage key subjSafe
      bodyEnc = encryptForStorage key bodyNorm
  in EmailRecord toEnc fromEnc subjEnc bodyEnc

-- | Send email by decrypting stored record and formatting SMTP commands
sendEmail :: BS.ByteString -> EmailRecord -> Handle -> IO ()
sendEmail key record h = do
  let to   = decryptFromStorage key (erTo record)
      from = decryptFromStorage key (erFrom record)
      subj = decryptFromStorage key (erSubject record)
      body = decryptFromStorage key (erBody record)
  -- Format and send SMTP conversation
  smtpSend h "EHLO mailservice.local"
  smtpSend h $ "MAIL FROM:<" <> from <> ">"
  smtpSend h $ "RCPT TO:<" <> to <> ">"
  smtpSend h "DATA"
  -- Headers in DATA section
  smtpSend h $ "From: " <> from
  smtpSend h $ "To: " <> to
  smtpSend h $ "Subject: " <> subj
  smtpSend h ""
  smtpSend h body
  smtpSend h "."
  smtpSend h "QUIT"

-- | Send a line over SMTP (appends CRLF)
smtpSend :: Handle -> BS.ByteString -> IO ()
smtpSend h line = do
  BS.hPut h line
  BS.hPut h "\r\n"
  hFlush h

-- | Process incoming email request from API
-- The Text input comes from a JSON API after UTF-8 decoding
processEmailRequest :: BS.ByteString -> T.Text -> T.Text -> T.Text -> T.Text -> Handle -> IO ()
processEmailRequest key toAddr fromAddr subject body h = do
  let record = buildEmailRecord key toAddr fromAddr subject body
  sendEmail key record h
